product.title: Cali Dreaming Electric Bike Tour of La Jolla and Pacific Beach

description.text: Ride an electric bike along San Diego's north coast with a guide, covering La Jolla viewpoints, beachfront stretches, and neighborhood highlights with less effort and more distance than a standard bike tour.

highlights: Electric bike route through La Jolla and Pacific Beach.
Coastal viewpoints with local guide commentary.
Beginner-friendly e-bike support on rolling terrain.
Small-group ride with frequent scenic stops.

start.description: Meeting point in La Jolla, San Diego.
